name: Bathroom
blurb: Baths, vanities and fittings that anchor the room.
description: Freestanding baths, oak vanities and floor-standing fillers — the larger pieces that set the tone of a bathroom. Each one is made to order, pressure-tested and covered by a written warranty.

name: Kitchen
blurb: Sinks and mixers for the hardest-working room in the house.
description: Fireclay Belfast sinks, quartz-composite bowls and solid-brass mixers, built for heavy daily use. Our kitchen pieces are cycle-tested to twice the industry standard before they leave the line.

name: Basins
blurb: Countertop and wall-hung forms in ceramic and stone.
description: Thin-rimmed countertop bowls, wall-hung slabs and vessels carved from solid stone. Every basin is glazed inside and out, fired at 1,220 °C and inspected by hand before it is packed.

name: Toilets
description: Rimless wall-hung, back-to-wall and close-coupled WCs with quiet 3/4.5 litre dual-flush mechanisms. Soft-close, quick-release seats are standard across the range.

name: Faucets
blurb: Single-lever mixers and spouts in solid brass.
description: Single-lever mixers, tall vessels and wall-mounted spouts cast in CW617N brass, fitted with ceramic disc cartridges rated for 500,000 cycles. Finished in chrome, brushed nickel or brushed brass.

name: Showers
blurb: Rain heads, columns and hand showers.
description: Ceiling-mounted rain heads, thermostatic columns and hand shower sets, engineered for an even, generous spray at Indian water pressures. Rub-clean nozzles throughout.
